items.headline: Piening scores late touchdown as UCF stuns Kansas 33-32
items.description: — Caden Piening reeled in a 6-yard reception with three seconds left on the clock to lift UCF over Kansas 33-32 on Saturday.

items.headline: Max Carroll's pick-6 and Jaden Craig's late touchdown lift TCU to 22-16 win over Kansas
items.description: — Max Carroll returned an interception 60 yards for a touchdown, quarterback Jaden Craig ran 17 yards for the go-ahead score with 1:09 remaining and TCU beat Kansas 22-16 on Saturday.
